title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $500 on the Roborock Qrevo Edge 3 Pro
excerpt: This self-cleaning sweeper eliminates one of your cleaning to-do list's biggest tasks.
content_html:
SAVE $500: As of Nov. 4, get the Roborock Qrevo Edge 3 Pro for $999.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,499.99. That's a discount of 33%.

Credit: Amazon

$999.99 at Amazon
$1,499.99 Save $500

If you're tired of vacuuming, you're not alone. It's a never-ending task that always has to be done, so it's understandable that you might be burned out on picking up dirt and debris every day or so. This is a task that, in 2026, you can outsource to a robot without blinking an eye, as there are tons of robot vacuums up to the task. We've found an early Black Friday deal on one that can handle the job with gusto, in fact.

As of Nov. 4, get the Roborock Qrevo Edge 3 Pro for $999.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,499.99. That's $500 off and a discount of 33%.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

The Roborock Qrevo Edge 3 Pro offers 36,000Pa of suction, meaning it can tackle even the toughest jobs. It uses its AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 to raise itself up to climb over thresholds, efficiently sweep carpets and and hardwood floors, and alternatively mop floors as you direct. It uses 360-degree scanning to make a precise map of your home so it can do all of this on its own without needing your input as well, with the capability to recognize over 300 obstacles and navigate around them.

It can clean closer to your corners, walls, and furniture thanks to its FlexiArm technology so those hard-to-reach nooks and crannies aren't an issue. And when it's time to mop, its mop attachment spins at 200 RPM with plenty of downward pressure to handle even sticky and stubborn stains without leaving residue. All this, and it can clean its own mop heads and empty itself.
